title: Testing & QA Engineer
description:
Testing & QA Engineer SDK & Security Validation 
 Department: R&D
 Location: Hyderabad
 
 Role Overview NPCI is seeking a detail-oriented and technically strong Testing & QA Engineer to join its Research & Development team. This role will focus on quality assurance, validation, and reliability testing of Android/mobile SDKs, with a strong emphasis on security-related developments, compliance, and robustness in payment-grade environments. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining and executing comprehensive QA strategies for SDKs, APIs, mobile components, and security-sensitive product features. The role requires experience in functional testing, automation testing, SDK validation, API testing, performance testing, and security-focused quality engineering. The candidate should be comfortable working closely with developers, architects, product teams, and security stakeholders to ensure high-quality and secure deliverables. 
 This role is especially relevant for candidates who understand the challenges of validating payment, authentication, cryptographic, and trust-sensitive mobile components in a structured R&D environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. SDK Testing and Quality Assurance Design, develop, and execute test strategies for Android/mobile SDKs and related software components. Validate SDK functionality across multiple Android versions,device types, OEM environments, and integration scenarios. Create detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and traceability matrices for SDK features and enhancements. Perform integration testing to verify SDK behavior when embedded into host applications. Ensure backward compatibility and stability of SDK releases across supported environments. Validate SDK installation, configuration, initialization, runtime behavior, error handling, and upgrade paths. 
 2. Security Validation and Secure QA Support Perform validation of security-sensitive features, including authentication flows, secure storage, device binding, cryptographic operations, token handling, and session management. Verify implementation of mobile security controls such as certificate pinning, root/jailbreak detection, tamper detection, obfuscation, and secure communication. Support review and validation of security requirements in SDK and mobile application workflows. Work closely with engineering and security teams to identify vulnerabilities, weak controls, insecure configurations, and risk areas early in the development lifecycle. Participate in security testing activities, including negative testing, abuse-case testing, and misconfiguration validation. Assist in validating compliance with secure coding and mobile security best practices. 
 3. Test Automation Build and maintain automated test frameworks for SDK and application validation. Develop automated functional, regression, integration, and API test suites. Automate repeatable test scenarios for SDK releases and continuous validation pipelines. Integrate automated test execution with CI/CD pipelines to improve release quality and reduce manual effort. Contribute to test infrastructure for emulator, real-device, and device farm-based testing. 
 4. API, Integration, and Platform Validation Validate SDK interaction with backend APIs, device services, and platform capabilities. Perform testing for network handling, retries, resilience, transaction integrity, and failure scenarios. Verify interoperability between SDK components and dependent systems. Support testing of mobile components involving NFC, device security modules, cryptographic interfaces, and secure communication layers where applicable. Ensure consistency of behavior across sandbox, UAT, and production-like test environments. 
 5. Performance, Reliability, and Resilience Testing Conduct performance, stress, load, and stability testing for SDKs and related mobile components. Validate app/SDK behavior under low memory, poor network, device interruptions, and edge-case conditions. Test for battery impact, startup latency, SDK footprint, crash resilience, and transaction reliability. Assess release readiness from a non-functional quality standpoint. 
 6. Defect Management and Quality Governance Identify, document, reproduce, prioritize, and track defects with clear technical detail. Work with developers to troubleshoot issues, validate fixes, and prevent regression. Maintain structured QA documentation including release reports, quality dashboards, and defect metrics. Support root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives for recurring quality issues. Contribute to definition and monitoring of QA gates and release acceptance criteria. 
 7. Collaboration and Process Improvement Work closely with R&D developers, product managers, architects, security teams, and external stakeholders. Participate in requirement reviews, design discussions, sprint planning, and release readiness reviews. Recommend improvements in QA processes, tooling, test coverage, and product quality standards. Contribute to a quality-first engineering culture within the R&D organization. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline. 5-8 years of relevant experience in software testing, QA engineering, or mobile/SDK validation. Hands-on experience in testing Android applications, mobile SDKs, APIs, or platform components. Strong understanding of software testing lifecycle, defect management, and quality processes. Experience in creating detailed manual and automated test artifacts. Familiarity with security-focused validation for mobile or payment-related products. 
 Required Technical Skills Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing concepts. Experience in Android/mobile testing across multiple OS versions and device profiles. Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, or equivalent. Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting for mobile/application testing. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated quality checks. Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar platforms. Strong debugging, log analysis, and issue reproduction skills. Understanding of secure communication, authentication models, and mobile security testing fundamentals. Working knowledge of cryptographic concepts, secure key handling, token validation, and transaction security is desirable. Exposure to performance and reliability testing tools is preferred. 
 Preferred Skills and Experience Experience testing SDKs intended for third-party developer integration. Exposure to payment systems, fintech products, authentication products, or regulated digital platforms. Familiarity with Android security architecture, keystore usage, app signing, and secure storage validation. Experience with security testing tools, static/dynamic analysis outputs, or vulnerability validation workflows. Understanding of NFC, host card emulation, secure elements, device attestation, or trusted execution concepts is an advantage. Experience in testing products that require high assurance, auditability, and compliance alignment. Exposure to Agile / Scrum development environments. 
 Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving ability High attention to detail and structured thinking Ability to identify edge cases and risk areas proactively Clear documentation and reporting skills Strong collaboration and cross-functional communication Ownership mindset and commitment to product quality Ability to work in an R&D environment with evolving requirements and rapid experimentation Role Expectations The selected candidate will be expected to: Ensure that SDK and security-focused deliverables meet high standards of quality, reliability, and trustworthiness Strengthen validation practices for mobile and security-critical components Improve release confidence through structured testing and automation Support the R&D team in delivering secure, scalable, and production-ready innovations 
 Why Join This Role This position offers an opportunity to work on next-generation digital payment and security technologies within NPCIs R&D ecosystem. The role provides meaningful exposure to mobile innovation, SDK quality engineering, secure platform validation, and payment-grade software assurance, with direct impact on products of national importance.
